## portalEnvironment

[Implementation, line 8](../../../../../src/render/portal/environment.ts#L8)

Destination state lasts through the remote scene render, then restores the main view.
Reuses the globe/textures; no extra geography, textures or network queue per portal.

```ts
portalEnvironment(geography: GeographicView, scene: THREE.Scene, remotePosition: THREE.Vector3, mainPosition: THREE.Vector3, renderOrigin: THREE.Vector3, clock: SkyClock, ambient: THREE.AmbientLight, lights: THREE.DirectionalLight[]): () => void
```
